generated.details: On the middle-plane tabletop at right, beside the laptop, place a small cream ceramic pastry plate with a shallow circular well and gently raised rim.
One croissant rests in its well, formed from rolled laminated dough with curved tapered ends and flaky golden layers.
Above the table, upper center-right, hang a pendant lamp whose cream metal dome shade connects to a slim ceiling cord, with its recessed bulb inside the shade.
